Based on my search, I found every file that names `LimitCheck` directly — as a type annotation, generic argument, `satisfies` position, or import. I excluded files that only call `checkLimit()`/`assertWithinLimit()` and read properties off the inferred result (e.g. `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx`, `tests/services/billing-service.test.ts`, `tests/server/plan-limits.test.ts`), and files that use `BillingSummary` (which itself contains `LimitCheck`) without naming `LimitCheck` directly (e.g. `usage-panel.tsx`, `settings/billing/page.tsx`). I also excluded `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` and `corpus-manifest.json` since those only contain `LimitCheck` inside string literals describing signatures, not actual TypeScript type references.

- `src/types/billing.ts` — defines the `LimitCheck` interface itself
- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts` — `checkLimit(): Promise<LimitCheck>`, imports `LimitCheck`
- `src/hooks/org-context.tsx` — `readonly limitChecks: readonly LimitCheck[]`, imports `LimitCheck`
- `src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts` — `checks: readonly LimitCheck[]` return type, imports `LimitCheck`
- `src/components/domain/billing/usage-meter.tsx` — `UsageMeterProps`, `usageRatio`/`usageTone` parameter types, imports `LimitCheck`
- `src/components/domain/billing/seat-limit-banner.tsx` — `SeatLimitBannerProps.check: LimitCheck`, imports `LimitCheck`
- `src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx` — `InviteMemberFormProps.seatCheck: LimitCheck`, imports `LimitCheck`
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx` — `seats satisfies LimitCheck`, imports `LimitCheck`
- `tests/helpers/factories.ts` — `makeLimitCheck(overrides: Partial<LimitCheck>): LimitCheck`, imports `LimitCheck`
- `tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts` — local `check(): LimitCheck` helper, imports `LimitCheck`

ANSWER: src/types/billing.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/hooks/org-context.tsx, src/hooks/use-plan-limits.ts, src/components/domain/billing/usage-meter.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/seat-limit-banner.tsx, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, tests/helpers/factories.ts, tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts
